messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads up — Atlasica QBR is next Tue. Their embedding rollout last week doubled queries and token spend spiked. Need a short cost prep + enablement sync this week.
lee_fin: Ack. Do we have a breakdown by route/model? I want to see embeddings vs completions.
marIa_cs: (typo) maria_cs: I pulled the high-level: embeddings ~72% of token spend, with a 3x increase in avg seq length for search requests. Their monthly commit still covers baseline but burst risk is real.
sam_se: Can you drop the raw numbers? I can prep a short playbook for throttles + cache suggestions.
maria_cs: Paste from our dashboard snapshot: 
```
month_window: 14 days
avg_daily_tokens_before: 45M
avg_daily_tokens_after: 135M
embeddings_share: 72%
```
lee_fin: Rough cost delta estimate: at their plan, ~+$4.3k/week. That's before any batching/caching wins.
jon_prod: For the enablement deck we should recommend: 1) client-side batching 2) prefix caching 3) downsampling embeddings for low-value queries. Also offer Dedicated pool option for predictable pricing.
tia_eng: We can quickly add an autoscale throttle rule on their ingestion route and enable KV prefix caching. Sam, I can prototype a config snippet.
sam_se: Sweet. For the QBR I want 2 slides: (a) "what changed" (b) "recommended actions + projected savings". Can someone run a 30/60/90 day spend projection using current traffic?
lee_fin: I'll run a burn projection. Quick ask: can we flag if credit cushion < 3 days at current run-rate? I can include that as a renewal risk signal.
maria_cs: Yes — please add that threshold. Also include a recommended safety-net (retainer/top-up) and an enablement checklist for Atlasica's infra team.
tia_eng: Prototype config for throttle + cache: 
```
route: /api/v1/embeds
throttle: 200rps burst=400
batching: enabled size=32
kv_cache: prefix_k=24 ttl=3600
```
jon_prod: Nice. Sam, I can sketch the slide numbers: Current weekly spend ~$12.1k -> projected w/o changes $16.4k -> with proposals ~$9.8k (net savings ~40%). Put conservative and optimistic columns.
sam_se: Perfect. Maria, can you own outreach to Atlasica to book a 30m pre-QBR to walk mitigations? I'll own the deck and enablement checklist.
maria_cs: On it. I'll ping @atlasica-team and propose Thu 11am.
deploy-bot: deployment:release/atlasica-throttle-config v2 promoted to staging (logs: https://ci.redwood/release/1234) :rocket:
lee_fin: Thanks — once staging perf looks good we can offer to deploy to their Dedicated trial.
maria_cs: Action items: Maria outreach, Sam deck, Lee projection + renewal flag, Tia config test, Jon slide copy. Check-in Fri EOD? :thumbsup:
sam_se: Friday EOD works. I'll attach a one-pager with rollback steps for each mitigation.
jon_prod: I'll add a customer-facing cost comparison table and example email language for renewals.
lee_fin: I'll add the credit cushion alert into Account Health dashboard and set a weekly pulse.
maria_cs: Great team. Closing loop here — thanks all.
_meta: Generated synthetic Slack thread for CS QBR cost prep; conforms to agents.md formatting: one continuous string of messages prefixed by sender names.
